description: Kansas 211 provides free, confidential referrals to local food, housing, health and other services. Live specialists have weekday hours.
introduction: Kansas 211 provides free, confidential referrals to local food, housing, health and other services. Live specialists have weekday hours.

sections.who: Anyone looking for resources can use the service. Individual providers decide whether applicants qualify for assistance.
sections.get: Telephone, text, chat and an online directory help locate community resources. Specialists can discuss more than one need.
sections.docs: Have your ZIP code, type of help needed and any deadline ready. For a referral, ask what the provider needs before sending financial documents.
sections.apply:
1. Call 211, text your ZIP code to 898211, or use United Way of the Plains’ chat. Live phone, text and chat hours are Monday–Friday, 7 a.m.–7 p.m.; after-hours calls receive recorded resource information.

  2. Search 211Kansas.org anytime. The United Way page links a separate directory for seven northeast Kansas counties.
sections.after: Contact the referred agency to confirm service area, current openings and application steps. A referral is not a benefit award.
